source.name: WildBench (AI2, Hugging Face Space)
source.description: WildBench v2 leaderboard data file of the official Hugging Face Space (last updated Aug 2024).
source.license: Apache-2.0 (project repository https://github.com/allenai/WildBench); the Space itself states no separate license
notes: Values copied unrounded from the Space's data file for K=-1 (length margin ∞, the Space default).
WB-Elo in this Space file differs from the GitHub file already imported as 'WildBench WB-Elo' (different snapshot, a few points apart), so both Raw and LC are given here as separate versions.
WB-Score per task category: the same values also appear in extra of the existing WB-Score rows (GitHub file); here they are separate benchmarks.
Reward is '-' (not computed) for 12 models; those are left out of wb_reward.
Model names are the Space's keys (63 models; a few differ from the GitHub file, e.g. 'dbrx-instruct' vs 'dbrx-instruct@together').
